servinfo.title: Fuel Injector Cleaning Procedure

item.ptxt: If injector cleaning is not performed periodically as specified in “Scheduled Maintenance”, fuel injectors could become inoperative affected by carbon deposits.
To mix cleaning agent with fuel, pour cleaning agent into fuel tank first and then fill up the tank.
For effective fuel injector cleaning, drive the vehicle until the tank becomes empty without refilling on the way.

servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the injector cleaning, observe Precautions for Fuel System Service:K14C .

s1.ptxt: If tank is full, drain fuel until the level becomes about two-thirds.
If fuel is drained, return it into the tank.
Drive vehicle until tank becomes empty.
